payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'comparing': the couple wants a way to judge any planner or agent before choosing who to speak with, so the invitation is a Wedded Concierge consultation at /wonderland-concierge, placed only where the post moves from neutral questions to Wedded Wonderland. CTA copy makes no comparison with travel agents and gives no figures; each subtext carries one brand-facts reassurance once: fee in writing (primary), inclusions in writing (secondary), one Wedded Advisor start to finish (closing). These match the questions the post tells readers to ask, so the CTA answers the page's own test without new claims. No 'free', perks, Privileges, availability or call-first wording. All four tracked links already appear once each with correct UTMs, so no copy change is made. A printable side-by-side question sheet for comparing two businesses would be a better-matched magnet; none is known to exist, so it is a backlog suggestion only and not placed.
